scope_note: Archive overview recovered through indexed primary-source text. All direct archive/PDF requests returned HTTP 503. This catalog contains provisional number/topic metadata for 12 problems from 2022, 2024, 2025 and makes no full-paper fidelity claim.
not_listed_note: Not listed in the inspected official archive overview; this is not a claim that a contest was canceled or that other material does not exist.

primary_source_discovery.retrieval_method: Official archive excerpt returned by web search; direct fetch failed.
primary_source_discovery.source_fidelity_limitation: Search-index render is sufficient for observed archive year and link-label inventory, not for reconstructing full papers or all href targets.

rights.publication_policy: Original editorial metadata and organizer links only. No third-party paper, extracted statement compilation, or solution text mirrored. The organizer archive encourages practice through its Problems links.

missing_coverage: Direct original archive HTML and PDFs unavailable during this inspection (HTTP 503), so no paper hashes or full-paper fidelity confirmation.
Only 2022, 2024, 2025 Category II problem numbers and topics inspected; 1997–2019 individual problems outside scope.
Direct old-year href targets not recovered; official archive landing-page links supplied instead of guessed paper URLs.
Category II Solutions links not located in archive rows for 1997–2006; this does not prove that official solutions do not exist.
2020, 2021, 2023 not listed in observed archive overview.
No Category II problem paper links observed for 1992–1996 and no Category II row observed for 1991.
